summary: Airfield EGUN closed within 5 nautical miles; flights during the closure need prior approval from a group commander.
text:
AD CLSD. FLT DURING CLOSURE PERIOD MUST BE PRIOR APPROVED ACFT, 
HAVE OPR NECESSITY OR BE HIGHER HEADQUARTERS DIRECTED MISSION AND 
MUST BE APPROVED BY 100 OPR GROUP COMMANDER. CTC COMMAND POST AT 
238-2121 DURING CLOSURE FOR APPROVAL/PPR REQ. CTC AIRFIELD 
MANAGEMENT AT 238-4130 PRIOR TO CLOSURE DATE FOR APPROVAL/PPR REQ.
